Having overtaken Tokai Teio and won her 
targeted race, the Arima Kinen, Nice 
Nature shed tears of joy.

Asked about the secret behind her victory 
in the post-race press conference, Nice 
Nature answered that it was the result of 
putting out everything she had.

She declared that as long as they 
continued to support her, she would never, 
ever betray the trust of her fans.

Brimming with confidence, she was 
undeniably the "sparkling" protagonist.
